parameters.name: All
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query all configuration sets. This parameter is optional.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword to search by name.

parameters.name: PageIndex
parameters.description: The page index. The value starts from 1. This parameter is required.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. This parameter is required.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dm config-set-list --page-index 1 --page-size 10 --keyword xxx --all false --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dm ConfigSetList --region cn-hangzhou --All false --PageSize 10 --Keyword xxx --PageIndex 1
